Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are already out in the middle now. Nizakat Khan and Muhammad Khan are the two openers for Hong Kong. Arshad Iqbal to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Hong Kong, on the other hand, will be somewhat happy with their bowling effort. Ayush Shukla set the tone for them with two early wickets which was followed by another one from Ehsan Khan and a couple more from Anas Khan. They were in control in the middle phase of the game and Mohammad Ghazanfar also picked up three scalps and checked the runs too. However, that last over from Shukla which went for 26 runs put a dent to their overall effort, but he picked two wickets on the last two balls to bowl Pakistan out. Now, it is up to their batters to gun this total down and make it to the semis. Join us in a bit to see how the chase unfolds.

Pakistan was shell-shocked with the quality bowling from Hong Kong and were reduced to 24 for 3 inside the Powerplay. Their top order failed miserably except for opener Omat who got some runs under his belt. Asif Ali and Arafat Minhas did the repair job for them with a 36-run stand but could not stay there till the end as both got out in their 20s. A quick-fire 41 off just 16 balls from Aamer Jamal which includes 26 runs from the last over took them to a decent total in the end and gives their bowlers a good chance in this match.

Despite that very expensive last over, Hong Kong have put in a good show with the ball here and to bowl out a side like Pakistan even if it is a second-string side is an achievement for them. They would have certainly taken 160 at the start of the game and this is a great opportunity for them to cause an upset here.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ayush Shukla ends proceedings with a wicket here. Goes full and wide again, Arshad Iqbal tries to reach out and hit it over deep point but ends up slicing it over backward point. Mohammad Ghazanfar in the deep comes in a bit and takes a safe catch as Shukla finishes with four wickets. 26 runs come off the final over and Pakistan are bundled out for 160 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the pre-match formalities and it's time to get the play underway! The umpires are out on the field and so are the players of Hong Kong. Omair Yousuf and Mirza Tahir Baig are the openers for Pakistan. Ayush Shukla will take the new ball for Hong Kong here. Let's go...
We are just a few minutes away from the start of the game but first, it is time for the national anthems. It will be the national anthem of Hong Kong first, followed by the Pakistan national anthem.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mirza Tahir Baig, Omair Yousuf, Rohail Nazir (WK), Haider Ali, Qasim Akram (C), Khushdil Shah, Asif Ali, Arafat Minhas, Aamer Jamal, Sufiyan Muqeem, Arshad Iqbal.
Hong Kong (Playing XI) - Babar Hayat, Akbar Khan, Anas Khan, Ehsan Khan, Muhammad Khan (WK), Shiv Mathur, Mohammad Ghazanfar, Nizakat Khan (C), Niaz Ali, Nasrulla Rana, Ayush Shukla.
Hong Kong have won the toss and elected to BOWL first.

Hong Kong, on the other hand, have momentum on their side with two wins and they will look to exploit it and put up a decent show in this game. Babar Hayat will be their key batter along with skipper Nizakat Khan, Nasrulla Rana and Shiv Mathur who will also need to contribute with the bat. Rana also has five wickets to his name and will look to add more to his tally while Ehsan Khan, Ayush Shukla, and Mohammad Ghazanfar make up a strong bowling attack which can challenge their opposition batters. Will we see an upset? Or will Pakistan get over the line as expected? We will find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

Pakistan have named a strong squad for this competition where Qasim Akram will be leading the side and they have quite a few experienced players like Khushdil Shah, Asif Ali, Shahnawaz Dahani and Usman Qadir who have already performed at the highest level. It is no secret that they have more quality in all departments and will be the favorites to progress to the semi-finals.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the 2nd Quarter Final in the Asian Games 2023 where Pakistan go up against Hong Kong. This will be the first game for the Men in Green in the tournament as they qualified directly due to their higher seeding while the latter worked hard and defeated Japan and Cambodia to book their spot in the knockouts and will hope to put up a good fight in this game.
